name: smart-scheduling-app
description: Smart Scheduling App for UCSC Students

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client" "npm run dev:agent"
scripts.setup:agent: python3.12 -m venv agent_service/.venv && agent_service/.venv/bin/pip install -r agent_service/requirements.txt
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules shared/node_modules server/node_modules client/node_modules shared/dist server/dist client/dist
